key_findings: Five c15 cybersecurity repository identities were independently content-gated and then deduplicated to an already-reviewed exact lineage.

withcrux/agentHack-skills has real CI, labs and MCP code, but many Skill-declared labs are absent from the pinned tree and the MCP project identifier is derived inconsistently between start and follow-up operations.

thunderstormwang/AgentSkills contains an explicit policy contradiction: git-commit requires confirmation before committing while implementation treats commits as pre-authorized; authorization must be centralized above individual Skills.

shengxuan-create/interview-skill has useful progressive disclosure and eval definitions, but the current repository does not reproduce the README's historical trigger-accuracy headline and company_intel.py references a missing result_evaluator.md artifact.
daonhan/Agentskills is well decomposed but text-only and dominated by one business methodology; its claims should be treated as heuristics rather than validated general rules.
